title: Ampere 電動渡輪
summary: 以Ampere電動渡輪為案例，聚焦短航段反覆循環和靠港補能；比較單次能量平衡與整天班次累積，避免只用一次充電判斷可行性。 各單元為獨立縮尺練習，串接的是驗證流程，不是同一實船的校準數位分身。
summaryEn: Use Ampere to focus on repeated short crossings and port replenishment, comparing one-trip balance with a full day of cycles rather than judging feasibility from a single charge. Units are independent scaled exercises connected by a verification workflow, not a calibrated digital twin of one vessel.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

steps.title: 分開車輛人員與電池質量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Separate vehicles, people and battery mass: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 分開車輛人員與電池質量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Separate vehicles, people and battery mass and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 分開車輛人員與電池質量：靜浮平衡時船舶總質量等於排開水的質量；載重、設備、燃料和船體質量應分欄。 本步以「船舶排水質量帳」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: Separate vehicles, people and battery mass: At static flotation, vessel mass equals displaced-water mass; payload, equipment, fuel and hull belong in separate ledger columns. Use Vessel displacement mass ledger to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是Ampere 電動渡輪實際規格：ρ=1025 kg/m³，排水體積V=540 m³。式 m=ρV，基準結果 553.5 t。條件：僅靜水質量平衡；不等於總噸位，也未判定完整穩度。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of Ampere electric ferry: ρ=1025 kg/m³, displacement volume V=540 m³. Formula m=ρV gives 553.5 t. Conditions: Static mass balance only; this is not gross tonnage and does not establish intact stability.
steps.failure: 把總噸位當質量會混淆容積指標與重量，先檢查資料欄位定義。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Treating gross tonnage as mass confuses a volume-based index with weight; inspect field definitions first. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 以四欄裝載表加總後與排水質量比對，標出尚未計入的人員、淡水與備品。 本案例另須檢查「分開車輛人員與電池質量」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Sum a four-column loading table and compare with displacement mass; flag omitted people, freshwater and spares. Also check that Separate vehicles, people and battery mass and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：分開車輛人員與電池質量。在渡輪班次卡、充電窗、假設電池與岸端緩衝表完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加排水體積10%，重算可平衡的質量，不推定可額外載客。 算式區的基準值為553.5，改變後為608.85 t。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Separate vehicles, people and battery mass. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Ferry timetable cards, charging windows, battery and shore-buffer ledger. Increase displacement volume alone by 10% and recalculate equilibrium mass without inferring additional passenger capacity. Baseline 553.5 changes to 608.85 t. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

knowledge.text: 把總噸位當質量會混淆容積指標與重量，先檢查資料欄位定義。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
knowledge.textEn: Treating gross tonnage as mass confuses a volume-based index with weight; inspect field definitions first. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：分開車輛人員與電池質量。在渡輪班次卡、充電窗、假設電池與岸端緩衝表完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加排水體積10%，重算可平衡的質量，不推定可額外載客。 算式區的基準值為553.5，改變後為608.85 t。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Separate vehicles, people and battery mass. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Ferry timetable cards, charging windows, battery and shore-buffer ledger. Increase displacement volume alone by 10% and recalculate equilibrium mass without inferring additional passenger capacity. Baseline 553.5 changes to 608.85 t. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

quiz.question: 哪一項正確描述本步應診斷的失效原因？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement correctly describes the failure to diagnose?
options: 把總噸位當質量會混淆容積指標與重量，先檢查資料欄位定義。
看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
登記總噸位的數字就是排水公噸。
optionsEn: Treating gross tonnage as mass confuses a volume-based index with weight; inspect field definitions first.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Registered gross tonnage numerically equals displacement tonnes.
quiz.explanation: 把總噸位當質量會混淆容積指標與重量，先檢查資料欄位定義。 以四欄裝載表加總後與排水質量比對，標出尚未計入的人員、淡水與備品。 本案例另須檢查「分開車輛人員與電池質量」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating gross tonnage as mass confuses a volume-based index with weight; inspect field definitions first. Sum a four-column loading table and compare with displacement mass; flag omitted people, freshwater and spares. Also check that Separate vehicles, people and battery mass and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

steps.title: 比較輕載重載吃水差：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Compare draft in light and heavy loading: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 比較輕載重載吃水差 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Compare draft in light and heavy loading and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 比較輕載重載吃水差：小幅裝載的平均吃水增量約為新增質量除以密度與水線面積；縱傾和水線面變化需另算。 本步以「水線面與平均吃水增量」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: Compare draft in light and heavy loading: For small loading changes, mean-draft increment is added mass over density and waterplane area; trim and changing waterplane need separate treatment. Use Waterplane area and mean-draft increment to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是Ampere 電動渡輪實際規格：新增質量m=108 t、ρ=1.025 t/m³、水線面積A=2000 m²。式 ΔT=Δm/(ρAw)，基準結果 0.052682927 m。條件：小變化、定水線面積與密度；不是港口吃水或裝載安全判定。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of Ampere electric ferry: Added mass m=108 t, ρ=1.025 t/m³, waterplane area A=2000 m². Formula ΔT=Δm/(ρAw) gives 0.052682927 m. Conditions: Small change at fixed waterplane area and density; not a port-draft or loading-safety determination.
steps.failure: 只看艏吃水可能把縱傾當整船下沉；至少需比較艏艉與重量分布。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Forward draft alone can confuse trim with overall sinkage; compare forward/aft draft and weight distribution. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 把平均吃水、艏吃水和艉吃水分欄，先核對港水密度，再比較新增重量。 本案例另須檢查「比較輕載重載吃水差」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Separate mean, forward and aft draft, verify harbor-water density and compare added weight. Also check that Compare draft in light and heavy loading and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of Ampere electric ferry: Added mass m=108 t, ρ=1.025 t/m³, waterplane area A=2000 m². Formula ΔT=Δm/(ρAw) gives 0.052682927 m. Conditions: Small change at fixed waterplane area and density; not a port-draft or loading-safety determination.
steps.failure: 只看艏吃水可能把縱傾當整船下沉；至少需比較艏艉與重量分布。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Forward draft alone can confuse trim with overall sinkage; compare forward/aft draft and weight distribution. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 把平均吃水、艏吃水和艉吃水分欄，先核對港水密度，再比較新增重量。 本案例另須檢查「比較輕載重載吃水差」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Separate mean, forward and aft draft, verify harbor-water density and compare added weight. Also check that Compare draft in light and heavy loading and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 比較輕載重載吃水差
knowledge.titleEn: Compare draft in light and heavy loading
knowledge.text: 只看艏吃水可能把縱傾當整船下沉；至少需比較艏艉與重量分布。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
knowledge.textEn: Forward draft alone can confuse trim with overall sinkage; compare forward/aft draft and weight distribution. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：比較輕載重載吃水差。在渡輪班次卡、充電窗、假設電池與岸端緩衝表完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加新增貨物質量10%，比較平均吃水增量，明示未計縱傾。 算式區的基準值為0.052682927，改變後為0.05795122 m。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Compare draft in light and heavy loading. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Ferry timetable cards, charging windows, battery and shore-buffer ledger. Increase added cargo mass alone by 10%, compare mean-draft increment and explicitly exclude trim. Baseline 0.052682927 changes to 0.05795122 m. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

quiz.question: 哪一項正確描述本步應診斷的失效原因？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement correctly describes the failure to diagnose?
options: 看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
新增貨物不論放哪裡，艏艉吃水都增加同樣數值。
只看艏吃水可能把縱傾當整船下沉；至少需比較艏艉與重量分布。
optionsEn: An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Added cargo causes equal forward and aft draft changes wherever it is placed.
Forward draft alone can confuse trim with overall sinkage; compare forward/aft draft and weight distribution.
quiz.explanation: 只看艏吃水可能把縱傾當整船下沉；至少需比較艏艉與重量分布。 把平均吃水、艏吃水和艉吃水分欄，先核對港水密度，再比較新增重量。 本案例另須檢查「比較輕載重載吃水差」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Forward draft alone can confuse trim with overall sinkage; compare forward/aft draft and weight distribution. Separate mean, forward and aft draft, verify harbor-water density and compare added weight. Also check that Compare draft in light and heavy loading and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.
